changes.description: Fixed flattening mixins so that when a shape uses multiple mixins that apply the same trait, the trait from the mixin that appears later in the list takes precedence, matching how traits are resolved when a model is loaded.

Stop treating the source location given to `ModelAssembler#addUnparsedModel` as a JAR to import. In-memory models with a `.jar` source location are now ignored with a warning. Use `addImport` to load JARs.
Fix quadratic-time duplicate detection in the `@uniqueItems` node validator.
Bumped the IDL version to 2.1.
Report resource mixins that define properties as a validation event instead of throwing an `IllegalStateException` from the model assembler.

Added the new `idx` trait to declare the expected wire order of a shape's members as well as the new `indexed` trait to declare that every structure and union in the closure of a service MUST be indexed.
Fixed Smithy IDL serialization of member and inline collection targets that reference public prelude shapes omitted from a programmatically built model.
Fixed `FileManifest` path validation so that paths containing `..` segments can no longer escape the manifest's base directory.

Added inline collection declarations to IDL 2.1, allowing list and map shapes to be declared directly in member target positions using `[Target]` and `{KeyTarget: ValueTarget}` instead of a separate top-level shape. The assembler generates one shared synthetic shape per distinct collection type in a namespace.
Added `aws.apigateway#apiGatewayConfig` trait, which defines the API Gateway configuration version for a service.

Added tagged string literals to IDL 2.1. Prefixing a string or text block with `#re`, `#b`, `#hex`, or `#timestamp` changes how its content is interpreted at parse time, making regular expressions, binary data, hex dumps, and RFC 3339 timestamps easier to write and read.
Improved performance when merging repeated array metadata values, which now scales linearly instead of quadratically.

Fixed super-linear regex backtracking when validating enum member and trait names, enum values, CloudWatch namespaces, ARN templates, and endpoint patterns, and when formatting generated trait Javadoc. Most of the affected regular expressions were replaced with linear scans.
Clarified that the order of values in concatenated list traits and metadata arrays is unspecified, and documented how `ModelAssembler` handles repeated shapes and metadata added in code.
Only load source context for validation events from local files and JARs.

Added syntax sugar for `idx` traits so that indexes can be defined more concisely. Models serialized with `SmithyIdlModelSerializer` will use this syntax by default and the Smithy formatter will update IDL 2.1+ models to use it.

Added the unstable `@discriminated` trait for modeling unions that are serialized as internally tagged objects in JSON, along with validation that members target structures and that the discriminator does not collide with a targeted structure member. Support for the trait is optional.
Added negative event stream protocol tests for oversized string headers, covering both single-byte ASCII overflow and multibyte UTF-8 byte-limit overflow.
Add since field for unstableFeatureInfo and explain for downgrade in diff event
Added support for setting a model to a bare major version, which will then resolve to the latest minor version of that major version. For example, "2" will resolve to "2.1".
